logger.doc:name: Log - Start Post Order
logger.message: #["Processing POST order request. Generated Order ID: " ++ vars.orderId]

db:select.doc:name: Select - Fetch Product Details
db:select.db:sql: SELECT UNIT_PRICE, STOCK_QUANTITY FROM PRODUCTS WHERE PRODUCT_CODE = :productCode

db:update.doc:name: Update - Deduct Stock
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE PRODUCTS SET STOCK_QUANTITY = STOCK_QUANTITY - :quantity, UPDATED_TIMESTAMP = NOW() WHERE PRODUCT_CODE = :productCode

db:insert.doc:name: Insert - Orders Table
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO ORDERS ( ORDER_ID, CUSTOMER_ID, CUSTOMER_NAME, CUSTOMER_EMAIL, ORDER_DATE, ORDER_STATUS, PRODUCT_CODE, QUANTITY, UNIT_PRICE, ORDER_TOTAL, CURRENCY, SHIPPING_ADDRESS_LINE1, SHIPPING_ADDRESS_LINE2, SHIPPING_CITY, SHIPPING_STATE, SHIPPING_POSTAL_CODE, SHIPPING_COUNTRY, CREATED_TIMESTAMP, UPDATED_TIMESTAMP, CORRELATION_ID ) VALUES ( :orderId, :customerId, :customerName, :customerEmail, :orderDate, :orderStatus, :productCode, :quantity, :unitPrice, :orderTotal, :currency, :shippingAddressLine1, :shippingAddressLine2, :shippingCity, :shippingState, :shippingPostalCode, :shippingCountry, NOW(), NOW(), :correlationId )
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ orderId: vars.orderId, customerId: vars.orderPayload.customerId default null, customerName: vars.orderPayload.customerName, customerEmail: vars.orderPayload.customerEmail, orderDate: vars.orderPayload.orderDate default (now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd"}), orderStatus: vars.orderPayload.orderStatus default "NEW", productCode: vars.orderPayload.productCode, quantity: vars.orderPayload.quantity as Number, unitPrice: vars.fetchedUnitPrice, orderTotal: ((vars.orderPayload.quantity as Number) * vars.fetchedUnitPrice), currency: vars.orderPayload.currency default "USD", shippingAddressLine1: vars.orderPayload.shippingAddressLine1, shippingAddressLine2: vars.orderPayload.shippingAddressLine2 default null, shippingCity: vars.orderPayload.shippingCity, shippingState: vars.orderPayload.shippingState, shippingPostalCode: vars.orderPayload.shippingPostalCode, shippingCountry: vars.orderPayload.shippingCountry, correlationId: correlationId }]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: "SUCCESS", message: "Order created successfully", orderId: vars.orderId, productCode: vars.orderPayload.productCode, quantity: vars.orderPayload.quantity as Number, unitPrice: vars.fetchedUnitPrice, orderTotal: (vars.orderPayload.quantity as Number) * vars.fetchedUnitPrice, correlationId: correlationId, timestamp: now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssXXX"} }

raise-error.doc:name: Raise Error - Insufficient Stock or Invalid Product
raise-error.description: #["Invalid product code or insufficient stock for product: " ++ (vars.orderPayload.productCode default "")]

logger.doc:name: Log - End Post Order
logger.message: #["Completed POST order request for Order ID: " ++ vars.orderId]

logger.doc:name: Log - Start Get Order
logger.message: #["Processing GET order request for Order ID: " ++ (vars.orderId default "")]

db:select.doc:name: Select - Orders Table
db:select.db:sql: SELECT ORDER_ID, CUSTOMER_ID, CUSTOMER_NAME, CUSTOMER_EMAIL, ORDER_DATE, ORDER_STATUS, PRODUCT_CODE, QUANTITY, UNIT_PRICE, ORDER_TOTAL, CURRENCY, SHIPPING_ADDRESS_LINE1, SHIPPING_ADDRESS_LINE2, SHIPPING_CITY, SHIPPING_STATE, SHIPPING_POSTAL_CODE, SHIPPING_COUNTRY, CREATED_TIMESTAMP, UPDATED_TIMESTAMP FROM ORDERS WHERE ORDER_ID = :orderId

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var order = vars.dbSelectResult[0] --- { orderId: order.ORDER_ID, customerId: order.CUSTOMER_ID, customerName: order.CUSTOMER_NAME, customerEmail: order.CUSTOMER_EMAIL, orderDate: if (order.ORDER_DATE != null) (order.ORDER_DATE as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd"}) else null, orderStatus: order.ORDER_STATUS, productCode: order.PRODUCT_CODE, quantity: order.QUANTITY, unitPrice: order.UNIT_PRICE, orderTotal: order.ORDER_TOTAL, currency: order.CURRENCY, shippingAddressLine1: order.SHIPPING_ADDRESS_LINE1, shippingAddressLine2: order.SHIPPING_ADDRESS_LINE2, shippingCity: order.SHIPPING_CITY, shippingState: order.SHIPPING_STATE, shippingPostalCode: order.SHIPPING_POSTAL_CODE, shippingCountry: order.SHIPPING_COUNTRY }

logger.doc:name: Log - End Get Order
logger.message: #["Completed GET order request for Order ID: " ++ (vars.orderId default "")]

logger.doc:name: Log - Start Patch Order
logger.message: #["Processing PATCH order request for Order ID: " ++ (vars.orderId default "")]

db:select.doc:name: Select - Check Order Exists
db:select.db:sql: SELECT ORDER_ID FROM ORDERS WHERE ORDER_ID = :orderId

db:update.doc:name: Update - Orders Table
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE ORDERS SET CUSTOMER_NAME = COALESCE(:customerName, CUSTOMER_NAME), CUSTOMER_EMAIL = COALESCE(:customerEmail, CUSTOMER_EMAIL), ORDER_STATUS = COALESCE(:orderStatus, ORDER_STATUS), SHIPPING_ADDRESS_LINE1 = COALESCE(:shippingAddressLine1, SHIPPING_ADDRESS_LINE1), SHIPPING_ADDRESS_LINE2 = COALESCE(:shippingAddressLine2, SHIPPING_ADDRESS_LINE2), SHIPPING_CITY = COALESCE(:shippingCity, SHIPPING_CITY), SHIPPING_STATE = COALESCE(:shippingState, SHIPPING_STATE), SHIPPING_POSTAL_CODE = COALESCE(:shippingPostalCode, SHIPPING_POSTAL_CODE), SHIPPING_COUNTRY = COALESCE(:shippingCountry, SHIPPING_COUNTRY), UPDATED_TIMESTAMP = NOW() WHERE ORDER_ID = :orderId
db:update.db:input-parameters: #[{ orderId: vars.orderId, customerName: payload.customerName default null, customerEmail: payload.customerEmail default null, orderStatus: payload.orderStatus default null, shippingAddressLine1: payload.shippingAddressLine1 default null, shippingAddressLine2: payload.shippingAddressLine2 default null, shippingCity: payload.shippingCity default null, shippingState: payload.shippingState default null, shippingPostalCode: payload.shippingPostalCode default null, shippingCountry: payload.shippingCountry default null }]

logger.doc:name: Log - Start Delete Order
logger.message: #["Processing DELETE order request for Order ID: " ++ (vars.orderId default "")]

logger.doc:name: Log - End Delete Order
logger.message: #["Completed DELETE order request for Order ID: " ++ (vars.orderId default "")]

logger.doc:name: Log - Start Get Product
logger.message: #["Processing GET product request for Code: " ++ (vars.productCode default "")]

db:select.doc:name: Select - Products Table
db:select.db:sql: SELECT PRODUCT_CODE, PRODUCT_NAME, STOCK_QUANTITY, UNIT_PRICE FROM PRODUCTS WHERE PRODUCT_CODE = :productCode

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var prod = vars.dbProductResult[0] --- { productCode: prod.PRODUCT_CODE, productName: prod.PRODUCT_NAME, stockQuantity: prod.STOCK_QUANTITY, unitPrice: prod.UNIT_PRICE }

logger.doc:name: Log - End Get Product
logger.message: #["Completed GET product request for Code: " ++ (vars.productCode default "")]

db:update.doc:name: Update - Increase Stock
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE PRODUCTS SET STOCK_QUANTITY = STOCK_QUANTITY + :quantity, UPDATED_TIMESTAMP = NOW() WHERE PRODUCT_CODE = :productCode

db:update.doc:name: Update - Deduct Stock
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE PRODUCTS SET STOCK_QUANTITY = STOCK_QUANTITY - :quantity, UPDATED_TIMESTAMP = NOW() WHERE PRODUCT_CODE = :productCode AND STOCK_QUANTITY >= :quantity

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: "SUCCESS", message: "Product stock updated successfully", productCode: vars.productCode, action: upper(vars.stockPayload.action), quantityChanged: vars.stockPayload.quantity, timestamp: now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssXXX"} }
